fusions.name: Passing Stroke
fusions.desc: A stroke at a target at or below 30% health that deals 30 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Wheeling Chop
fusions.desc: Pivots on your haunches and lashes out, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Edged Shoes
fusions.desc: Your slashing damage rises by 30% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Weight Behind It
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
